caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) for two models—Transformer and MoHD—under varying ratios of shared sub-dimensions to total sub-dimensions, ranging from 0/4 to 4/4. The x-axis, labeled "Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims," is linear and discrete, with tick marks at intervals of 1/4, spanning from 0/4 to 4/4. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL," is linear and ranges from 10.0 to 12.5, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The Transformer model is represented by a dashed red line, which remains constant at approximately 11.75 across all shared sub-dimension ratios. The MoHD model is represented by a solid blue line with square markers, which starts at approximately 11.2 at 0/4, decreases to around 10.5 at 3/4, and then slightly increases to about 10.8 at 4/4. The shaded light blue area under the MoHD line indicates the region bounded by its values, emphasizing its variation across the x-axis.
